description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It also includes macros for non-copyable and non-movable classes, and contains licensing information.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for managing expected input values, supporting discrete sets, ranges, and regular expressions, with validation methods.

classes.name: ValidatorBase
classes.description: Base class for validators, providing a virtual destructor.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class inheriting from ValidatorBase, encapsulating validation logic using expected values or custom functions.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: ExpectedValues::validate
methods.description: Validates a value against the expected values, range, or regex.

methods.name: Validator::validate
methods.description: Validates a value using either expected values or a custom function.

methods.name: ValidationManager::addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the manager, either by expected values or a custom function.

methods.name: ValidationManager::validate
methods.description: Validates a value against a named validator.

methods.name: ValidationManager::setLogger
methods.description: Sets a custom logging function for validation messages.
